querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      s_info_name,
                                      bid_trade_time,
                                      bid_quotingparty,
                                      bid_clean_price,
                                      bid_num,
                                      bid_price,
                                      bid_yield_to_maturity,
                                      ask_trade_time,
                                      ask_quotingparty,
                                      ask_clean_price,
                                      ask_num,
                                      ask_price,
                                      ask_yield_to_maturity,
                                      rate,
                                      bid_order_number,
                                      ask_order_number,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_cbondfixedincomeplatform.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.cbondfixedincomeplatform WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
